1: Contents page. A whole section box and one box per entry are both plausible outputs; box count alone is not a quality score. The small model also proposes a large enclosing region.
2: Sanskrit title and opening verse. Notice inconsistent splits within centered text and nested model boxes. The detector labels have no dedicated verse category.
3: Sanskrit prose, centered verse and small apparatus. The geometric baseline preserves the page but does not consistently separate the apparatus or keep the verse together.
9: Sanskrit commentary and verse. At threshold 0.50, V3 leaves nearly half the measured ink uncovered. Lowering to 0.30 recovers most of it; pixel recovery handles much of the remainder.
17: Two verses interleaved with commentary. Several methods split a verse into lines, or attach its last line to the following prose. Extra coverage does not solve that grouping problem.
25: Several verse/prose transitions. The small detector omits substantial verse text. The geometry baseline tends to carry the last verse line into a prose region.
33: Useful counterexample to coverage as accuracy: the small model covers almost all ink using an enclosing body box, while losing the internal verse/commentary structure.
49: Page with a short body and closing ornament. Missing ornaments contribute to the ink metric even when text is present. Avoid treating every recovered mark as a text block.
57: The small model misses verse material. V3 at 0.30 covers almost all measured ink, but tends toward one region per verse line.
65: Sanskrit with an embedded English gloss. Verse fragments receive weaker model scores than prose. Pixel recovery protects content, with further grouping still needed.
81: Pencil/scan marks and centered verse. The remaining uncovered ink includes material the detectors do not interpret as text. The mask is a diagnostic, not a transcription oracle.
97: A strong confidence-threshold example. V3 coverage changes from about 33% at 0.50 to about 96% at 0.30. This is calibration sensitivity, not proof that the page has no detectable structure.
113: A real geometry failure: line-band grouping loses substantial text on this crowded page. Both learned detectors preserve considerably more. A deterministic algorithm can still omit content.
114: English translation begins. All approaches find useful text blocks; some numbered entries are merged by the geometric baseline. Heading ornaments remain a separate question.
121: Regular English paragraphs. Learned layout detection works well here. The geometric baseline mainly misses the running page number rather than body text.
137: Short English page with a large blank area. Closing ornaments and speckles explain part of the uncovered-ink score. Main paragraphs are found by all methods.
145: English numbered entries. Geometry merges adjacent entries that the models generally separate, despite essentially complete ink coverage.
161: English translation. The geometry baseline is too coarse for individual numbered entries; the learned layouts give more useful paragraph divisions.
169: Dense mixed-language notes. Main entries are identified by all methods. Pixel recovery can expand a tiny running header into an unnecessarily broad box if nearby noise is present.
177: Dense English notes with Sanskrit quotations. Major paragraph divisions are consistent. Small in-line script changes do not require separate regions.
193: Mixed-script commentary. All approaches provide usable coarse blocks. Check label semantics and box tightness before deciding that the regions are interchangeable.
209: Dense mixed-script notes. Content coverage is high for all approaches, while large commentary blocks remain large. Reading order is simple on this single-column page.
233: Another geometry failure: some complete text lines fall outside its blocks. Both learned detectors cover those lines. Pixel verification is useful for either family of algorithm.
252: Short final page. Model footer detections include the digitization watermark; the hybrid excludes that known watermark band. Isolated marks still need a keep/ignore decision.
